\hline
\cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot & \cdot \\

\end{array}

- Numbers congruent to 1 mod 3: 1, 4, 7, 10 (4 numbers)

**No two adjacent cells can contain numbers from the same residue class modulo 3.**
